lines.text: Then was Venus like her mother; for her father is but grim.
lines.plainText: Then was Venus like her mother for her father is but grim

lines.text: Do you hear, my mad wenches?
lines.plainText: Do you hear my mad wenches

lines.text: No.
lines.plainText: No

lines.text: What, then, do you see?
lines.plainText: What then do you see

lines.text: Ay, our way to be gone.
lines.plainText: Ay our way to be gone

lines.text: You are too hard for me.
